Publication statement: Shanghai : Dian shi zhai, Qing Guangxu 10 nian jin shen [1884]
Revision of map originally drawn by Xu Yucang in 1875.

Revision of map originally drawn by Xu Yucang in 1875. Shows foreign concessions in Shanghai. Chinese area in yellow, French in red, British in blue, and American in orange. Includes text. Scale ca. 1:5400. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. AACR2: 650/1; 651/2; 700
